rationale: The v2 limiter was weak standalone willingness to pay and hard-to-copy advantage beside mature risk suites, compounded by sensitive-data procurement and direct operator sales. V4 changes the buyer, payer, distribution, control point and revenue unit to an auditor-embedded, operator-hosted batch assurance workflow; the partner owns implementation, qualified review and operator access. It does not assert demand, commitment, lawful access, pricing or margins, which remain explicit validation gates.
